channel.title: Scout Daily — AI Intelligence Feed
channel.description: Daily AI case studies and industry news for IT engineers and AI consultants.

item.title: [News] Where was Nvidia’s security team?
item.description: Nvidia’s security chief departed in August, and CEO Jensen Huang has since stepped down amid concerns over alleged chip diversion to China, highlighting a covert leak that corporate security teams often miss.

item.title: [News] This AI Tamagotchi Turns Everyday Objects Into Needy Virtual Pets
item.description: Daehwa Kim’s OATs (Object Agent Twins) are inexpensive micro‑AI avatars that attach to everyday objects, using E‑Ink displays and sensors to provide real‑time feedback via Google Gemini‑generated visuals. While still a research prototype, the system demonstrates how AI can extend into physical devices, offering a new avenue for user engagement.

item.title: [News] We're Asking an Appeals Court to Require a Warrant for ALPR Searches
item.description: A coalition of civil liberties groups has filed an amicus brief urging a U.S. appellate court to mandate warrants for automated license‑plate‑reader (ALPR) searches, arguing that the technology constitutes mass surveillance and violates Fourth Amendment privacy rights.

item.title: [News] Court denies motion to dismiss DRAM price fixing case
item.description: A federal judge denied Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron's attempt to dismiss a class action alleging they conspired to limit conventional DRAM supply and shift capacity to high‑bandwidth memory (HBM). The decision keeps the lawsuit alive, potentially impacting DRAM pricing and availability for data centers and AI workloads.

item.title: [News] AI DJs Completely Kill My Groove
item.description: YouTube Music’s beta AI DJ, "Beyond the Beat," was introduced in 2025 and now offers music context commentary during streams. The feature, while experimental, has shown inconsistent and sometimes intrusive content, prompting users to disable it.
